{'text': '據報 Apple 的全新 HomeView 早於數年前已基本完成，卻一再延遲推出。以下是根據 Apple 重要高層的言論，解釋 HomeView 為何要到現在才能面世。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple’s new HomeView was reportedly mostly finished for years, but kept getting delayed. Here’s why HomeView couldn’t launch until now, per quotes from key Apple execs.'}

{'text': 'Apple 強調具備個人化脈絡理解及對話能力的 Siri AI 對 HomeView 至關重要', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple touts Siri AI with personal context and conversational abilities as essential to HomeView'}

{'text': '2024 年 11 月，Mark Gurman 發表了一篇關於現命名為 HomeView 產品的深度報導。當時他指 Apple 目標是在 2025 年 3 月推出。然而該日期一再押後，現在 HomeView 終於將於 2026 年 11 月 13 日正式進入用戶家中。', 'paragraph_context': 'In November 2024, Mark Gurman published an in-depth report on the product we now know as HomeView. At the time, he said Apple was targeting a March 2025 launch. But that date kept slipping, and now HomeView will finally arrive in homes on November 13, 2026.'}

{'text': '為何等待如此之久？Gurman 一再指出 Siri AI 是延遲的主要原因。Apple 高層在接受 The Verge 訪問時的言論，現在亦大致印證了這一點。', 'paragraph_context': 'Why the long wait? Gurman has repeatedly pointed to Siri AI as the chief cause of delays. And Apple execs have now largely confirmed that in quotes given to The Verge.'}

{'text': 'Jennifer Pattison Tuohy 向 Apple 智能家居產品營銷副總裁 Kaiann Drance 提問，為何現在是推出 HomeView 及重新進軍智能家居市場的合適時機。', 'paragraph_context': 'Jennifer Pattison Tuohy asked Kaiann Drance, Apple’s VP of product marketing for home, why now was the right time for HomeView and Apple’s renewed smart home push.'}

{'text': '她表示 Siri AI 及其帶來的個人化脈絡理解，她稱之為 Apple 的「私隱理念」，與一款專為家居而設計的裝置結合得天衣無縫。「憑藉 Siri AI 的魔力，它以一種我們以往無法實現的方式完美融合。」她說道。', 'paragraph_context': 'She said Siri AI and the personal context it brings, which she called Apple’s “privacy story,” came together with a device designed specifically for the home. “With the magic of Siri AI, it comes together in a way that we haven’t been able to deliver before,” she said.'}

{'text': 'HomeView 被定位為一款共享裝置，能夠以 Siri AI 推出前無法做到的方式，運用用戶的個人化脈絡。因此不難想像，若缺乏更具個人化功能的 Siri，Apple 的主要宣傳賣點將不得不改變。', 'paragraph_context': 'HomeView is being marketed as a shared device that taps into users’ personal context in a way that wasn’t possible pre-Siri AI. So it’s easy to see how Apple’s main pitch would need to change without the more personalized Siri.'}

{'text': 'Apple AI 產品營銷副總裁 Lilian Rincon 也作出了類似的解釋。她向 The Verge 表示，Siri AI 是 HomeView 的核心，因為它「能力更為強大」，同時強調其對話能力令所有家庭成員都能輕鬆使用。', 'paragraph_context': 'A similar explanation was given by Apple’s Lilian Rincon, VP of product marketing for AI. She told The Verge that Siri AI is core to HomeView because it’s “much more capable” and also highlighted its conversational abilities, which make it easy to use for any family member.'}

{'text': '「它非常棒，因為你可以用非常自然的方式請它調校恒溫器溫度。隨着 Siri AI 功能持續進化，與家居體驗的互動亦變得適合以這種自然方式進行。」談到為何選在此時推出時，Rincon 表示這種自然語言的轉變正是 AI 走向主流的轉捩點。「因為現在無論是我的奶奶還是在讀大學的 Z 世代，都可以用他們自然的說話方式使用它，並獲得他們想要的結果。」', 'paragraph_context': '“It’s great because you can just ask it to change the temperature on your thermostat in a very natural way. As the Siri AI capabilities continue to evolve, the home experience is fitting to be able to interact with in this natural way.” On why now, Rincon says the natural-language shift is the point where AI goes mainstream. “Because now it can be … my mother-in-law or the Gen Z who’s in college, both of them can use this in the way that they naturally speak and get what they want.”'}

{'text': '熱門留言由 Jim Huls 發佈', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by Jim Huls'}

{'text': '這款產品的發展方向令人期待。', 'paragraph_context': "It'll be interesting to where this product goes."}

{'text': '我認為它現在的形態基本上是一時流行的產物……家中的擺設玩物。Homeview 的軟件／系統部分或許會朝不同方向發展，但硬件與軟件的組合……我實在看不出它的價值所在。', 'paragraph_context': 'I see it in its current form as mostly a fad like device...conversation piece in the home. Homeview, the software/OS piece might go in some different directions though. The hardware/software combination though...just not seeing it.'}

{'text': '希望 Ternus 能夠推出一些新而更好的產品，如果他們打算涉足傳統電腦裝置以外的領域。HomeView 給我的感覺像是某人的心血來潮之作，雖然有些人心知肚明，卻無能為力或不願直言反對。', 'paragraph_context': "Hoping Ternus gets some new and better products out if they're going to stray outside of traditional computing devices. HomeView strikes me as someone's pet project and there were people who knew better but couldn't or wouldn't tell them otherwise."}

{'text': '這是我們近期看到的產品。', 'paragraph_context': "Here's what we have lately."}

{'text': 'Apple Vision Pro——昂貴的奢侈品玩意。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Vision Pro - Expensive luxury toy.'}

{'text': 'HomeView——15 年前的舊概念配上差強人意的 AI。不過它看起來確實可愛！', 'paragraph_context': 'HomeView - 15 year old paradigm meets inadequate AI. It looks cute though!'}

{'text': 'Apple TV——「我們不會透過送硬件來賣服務。要的是利潤率！噢對吧，再加點 AI 進去！」', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple TV - "We don\'t give hardware away to sell services. Profit margins! Oh yeah, throw some of that AI in there!"'}

{'text': '我討厭所有「如果 Jobs 還在世，他一定會做某某事」的帖文，但 HomeView 確實像一款在今時今日理應被打槍的產品。人們生活中已經有手機、平板和電腦，它們在這類用途上表現得更出色。你會說，但嫲嫲可以坐在她梳化旁邊用它。不會的。嫲嫲不會坐在梳化旁邊用它，因為轉頭用 FaceTime 會弄得她頸部痠痛。', 'paragraph_context': 'I hated all of the "If Jobs were still around, he would have done xyz" posts but HomeView reeks of a product that in this day and age would have been killed. People already have phones, tablets, and computers in their lives that they use for this sort of thing and better at that. You say but grandman could use this next to her chair. No. Grandma isn\'t using this next to her chair when it hurts her neck to twist to use facetime.'}

{'text': '無論如何，我希望有人能想到真正令這硬件值回票價的用途。它引起我的興趣，但並非基於他們目前的市場推廣方式及其聲稱要解決的問題。', 'paragraph_context': "At any rate I'm hoping someone thinks of a use cases that this hardware is actually worth the money. It intrigues me but not based on how they're marketing it and what it's supposed to solve."}

{'text': '這種強調與解釋，也令 HomeView 未在歐盟推出變得更合理。', 'paragraph_context': 'This emphasis and explanation also makes HomeView’s absence in the EU more understandable.'}

{'text': '如果 Siri AI 只是一項錦上添花的功能，附加在一款本身功能豐富的產品上，那它在歐盟仍可能如期推出。但若整個產品的核心價值都圍繞着這款新助手及其個人化功能，那麼等到 Siri AI 在歐盟的 iOS 上可用時才推出，便更為合理。', 'paragraph_context': 'If Siri AI was simply a nice-to-have addition to an otherwise feature-rich product, perhaps it could launch in the EU still. But if the whole value proposition revolves around the new assistant and its personalized features, waiting until Siri AI is available for iOS in the EU makes more sense.'}
